cities.name: Dalat
cities.description: Highlands with a mild climate and pine forests. There is no dense undergrowth, so you can freely leave the trails and make your way through the forest. Long climbs, clean mountain air, and high-speed rides on a "carpet" of needles await you. We also recommend hiking Langbiang Mountain and karting.

cities.name: Nha Trang
cities.description: Routes through real jungles to hidden waterfalls. You will walk through rocky areas and mountain riverbeds, see the wild nature of Vietnam from the inside, and climb to observation points with panoramic views of the entire bay and coastal islands. Nha Trang is also ideal for diving, SUP, and beach relaxation.

cities.name: Da Nang
cities.description: A stunning combination of mountains and ocean. Ride through the legendary Hai Van Pass, explore the caves of the Marble Mountains, and catch the sunrise on Son Tra Peninsula among wild monkeys. Da Nang is a top spot for surfing at My Khe Beach, paragliding, and active cycling along the coast.

cities.name: Mui Ne
cities.description: Desert landscapes. Huge expanses of white and red dunes, riding along the ocean's edge, and high-speed sections. A unique experience of riding a bike on deep sand surrounded by incredible views like in the game GTA. You can also master kitesurfing, surfing, or driving quad bikes in this city.

advantages.title: Free training for beginners
advantages.description: During the tour, we will teach you everything from the basics of clutch operation and gear shifting to confidently overcoming obstacles on an off-road bike.

advantages.title: Category A driver's license is not required
advantages.description: It's advisable to have an IDP for safe driving. But let's be honest, we're in Vietnam, and the police here are very lenient towards tourists.

advantages.title: Trails of any complexity
advantages.description: Vietnam is an enduro paradise: misty mountains, waterfalls, tea plantations, and hidden trails. We'll tailor a route to suit you—from easy beginner routes with panoramic views to hardcore pro routes with adrenaline-pumping descents and challenges!

advantages.title: Simple booking
advantages.description: We've made our service as simple as possible so you can enjoy your motorcycle trip worry-free. We offer some of the most competitive prices.

reviewCopy: Enduro Vietnam: Fully Geared Rider Ready for Da Lat Forest Trails

We decided to go on this enduro tour to Dalat together with my father. He has a lot of motorcycle riding experience, and I have almost zero. Honestly, I was very worried that without the skills, the whole trip would go down the drain. But in reality, everything turned out differently: in just 1-2 hours, Andrey "put" me behind the wheel, sorted out the basics and subtleties of driving.

In the remaining time, we really went for it — we rode through the jungle, rocky trails, off-road, hills, and mountain slopes of the Central Highlands. We both had a great time, and this adventure set the tone for our entire trip to Vietnam! 😊 I would especially like to mention Andrey's coaching skills — he is an expert in working with beginners and truly opened up the magical world of enduro to my father and me. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking adrenaline in the cool heights of Dalat!

My wife, Yulia, gave me this tour as a birthday present, knowing how much I love motorcycles. She had only a couple of hours of experience on a cross-country track, so she was really nervous for the first three days of the tour. I'm not a professional enduro rider either. However, Boris, the coach (yes, he's a coach, as this is more of a training session with adventure elements than just a trip), didn't seem to mind our lack of experience.

He spent at least an hour on the training ground to get a person back on their feet, and by the way, Yulia even drove on her own, albeit only in a straight line ;) In the end, Boris made a bold decision: he took Yulia as his second rider on his bike. Together, we covered about 60 km of rough terrain, including rocks, ditches, and steep inclines and descents in the vicinity of Dalat. To be honest, at times it seemed that the next obstacle was physically impossible to overcome, but seeing how easily Boris handled it (and with a passenger!), I was inspired and followed suit. Of course, the equipment and gear took a beating... Every second of this route will be etched in my memory forever, and my casual interaction with Boris left a lasting positive impression. The final "finishing touch" was a personal gift from him! It touched me to the core! This outing to the cool heights of Dalat is worth more than any price — the memories are priceless! I recommend it to all couples seeking adrenaline and a connection with nature. 😊
